permittedTransformations.rule: React, ReactDOM, Testing Library, @floating-ui/react self-imports, and upstream relative source imports retarget their Octane equivalents.
Text input onChange handlers become onInput, and the Escape-key driver dispatches a native keydown event so Octane's delegated native listener observes it.
Octane mutable ref type arguments explicitly include null where React's useRef overload infers it.
Three delay-group assertions replace React's incidental render totals with a stronger assertion that Octane performs no extra render after the observed state settles.
Iframe assertions use isConnected and the iframe document's activeElement instead of jest-dom matchers bound to the outer document realm.
Upstream visual fixtures import repo-authored Octane Drawer, Navigation, MenuVirtual, icon, checkbox, and React compatibility support modules.
Generated adaptations may differ in formatting and relative paths recorded by the deterministic materializer.
